labels.s4:
4. master starts a full replication
and sends all of its data to
slave to synchronize the data
labels.s2:
2. slave has an internal scheduled task
that checks every second whether a
master needs connecting; if so, it sets
up a socket network connection
with master
labels.s3:
3. If master has requirepass configured,
the replica node sends the masterauth
password over to authenticate
labels.s1:
1. slave starts and saves the host
and ip of master node locally
labels.s5:
5. Every time master receives new data,
it sends it asynchronously to the replica node
labels._desc: The slave saves the master's address, connects over a socket, authenticates with masterauth if needed, then the master replicates all data and afterwards sends new data asynchronously.
